name: Magnetic Wireless Power Bank 10,000mAh
description: A slim power bank that snaps onto compatible phones and charges wirelessly, with a USB-C port for cables. Small enough for a pocket, big enough to top up a phone about two times.
bullets: Magnetic wireless charging for compatible phones

name: Portable USB-C Blender 380ml
description: Blend smoothies and shakes anywhere. Rechargeable over USB-C, with a cup that doubles as your travel bottle. Rinse by blending warm water with a drop of soap.

name: Sunrise Alarm Clock Lamp
description: A bedside lamp that brightens gradually before your alarm, then wakes you with a soft sound. Also works as a dimmable reading light.

name: Foldable Aluminum Laptop Stand
description: Raise your laptop to eye level and let air flow underneath. Folds flat to fit in a bag, with adjustable height for different desks.

name: Insulated Steel Water Bottle 750ml
description: Double-wall stainless steel bottle that keeps drinks cold or hot for hours. Leak-resistant lid and a wide mouth that fits ice cubes.

name: Silicone Kitchen Utensil Set (12 pcs)
description: A twelve-piece cooking set that is gentle on non-stick pans. Heat-resistant silicone heads with sturdy handles and a holder to keep the counter tidy.

name: Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds
description: Lightweight wireless earbuds with a compact charging case and touch controls. Quick pairing and a comfortable fit for commuting and workouts.

name: Magnetic Car Phone Mount
description: A low-profile dashboard or vent mount that holds your phone with strong magnets. One hand to attach, one hand to remove.
bullets: Fits most phones with the included metal plate
